title: Lien Payoff Service Schedule for Trade-In Agreements
content:
How Kestrel pays off a loan or lease on a traded vehicle directly to the lienholder is governed, grade by grade, by the figures and switches below for **Trade-In Agreements**.

| Term | Inoperable | Rough | Fair | Good | Very Good | Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payoff quote maximum age (calendar days from the quote date to the payoff send date) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Payoff send deadline (business days after pickup) | 3 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Late per-diem switch: per diem for days Kestrel sends after its own deadline is borne by Kestrel | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Payoff is sent only after any negative equity has been covered | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Channels Kestrel uses to pay a lienholder | Wire, overnight check | Wire, overnight check | Wire, overnight check | Wire, overnight check | Wire, overnight check | Wire, overnight check |
| A payoff quote is used only after Kestrel has confirmed it directly with the lienholder | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Schedule notes

- **Send deadline.** Kestrel's payoff send deadline is 3 business days after pickup for the Inoperable, Rough and Fair grades and 2 business days after pickup for the Good, Very Good and Excellent grades.
- **Quote age.** At every grade a payoff quote may be relied on while it is no more than 10 calendar days old on the send date.
- **Verification.** At every grade the quote must have been confirmed by Kestrel directly with the lienholder before it is used.
- **Channels.** The lienholder is paid by wire or by overnight check; no other channel appears on this schedule.

## Quick lookups

| Question | Answer from this schedule |
|---|---|
| Send deadline for a Fair Condition Offer | 3 business days after pickup |
| Send deadline for an Excellent Condition Offer | 2 business days after pickup |
| Is a quote 11 days old on the send date within the maximum age? | No, the maximum is 10 days |
